metadata.Name: FRASIMED
metadata.Description: FRASIMED is a French annotated corpus for medical entity detection and linking, created using crosslingual annotation projection from Spanish datasets.
metadata.Paper Title: FRASIMED: a Clinical French Annotated Resource Produced through Crosslingual BERT-Based Annotation Projection
Affiliations: Division of Medical Information Sciences (SIMED), University Hospitals of Geneva
Department of Radiology and Medical Informatics, University of Geneva
metadata.Abstract: This paper introduces FRASIMED, a French annotated corpus for medical entity detection and linking. FRASIMED was created using a crosslingual annotation projection approach, leveraging existing Spanish annotated datasets. The corpus comprises 2,051 synthetic clinical cases in French, making it the largest open annotated corpus for oncological concepts in French.
